sam: Starting follow-up: postmortem actions for last night's DNS+LB retry surge. Owners + short ETAs below. Please ack and add PR/ticket links.

nora: ack. quick root-cause recap?

sam: control-plane write stalled during maintenance -> route-update API returned 500s for ~90s. clients fell back to resolver cache with mixed region ordering. recent LB change reduced stickiness -> simultaneous cross-region retries and TLS handshake spike.

ed: i'll own control-plane mitigation: add server-side circuit-breaker + jittered retry and a short write-ack window to avoid partial propagation. ETA: patch in 48h, rollout in 96h. WIP branch soon.

viv: i'll handle LB guardrails: per-route cross-region cap + canary flag + rollback tag. ETA: canary config in 24h, rollback playbook 36h.

mohan: telemetry + alerts. proposing: (1) route_update_5xx_rate > 0.25% over 5m -> Pager, (2) cross_region_retry_ratio > 6% over 3m -> SRE. will add dashboard panels and synthetic probe for 500->resolver fallback. ETA: 3h for alerts.

sam: Action items summary:
1) ed  control-plane CB + write-ack gating (48/96h)
2) viv  LB canary + cap + rollback doc (24/36h)
3) mohan  telemetry + alerts + synthetic probe (3h / schedule)
4) nora  registrar follow-up + edge TTL alignment (EOD)

nora: opened registrar ticket RG-12377, asking about sub-minute TTL behavior and cache-invalidate API. added edge owners.

```

[2027-10-11T02:17:06Z] lb: duplicate flows detected -> dropped=430
```

mohan: dashboard link once panels are up: https://console.redwood/intern/dash/2823456789

viv: sample LB config for canary:
```json
{"cross_region_burst_limit":45,"health_gate":true,"rollback_marker":"rb-2823456789"}
```
PR for canary will be posted after ed's CB merges.

ed: WIP branch: github.com/redwood/control-plane/compare/cb-and-write-ack-282. will push tests tomorrow.

nora: registrar replied: they will test sub-60s TTL support; recommend control-plane debounce of rapid route pushes as temporary mitigation.

mohan: synthetic probe scheduled syn-55321 to simulate route-update 500 + mixed TTLs once PRs merged.

sam: We'll run daily check-ins in this thread for 4 business days and a wrap sync Friday 16:00 UTC. Please update PR/ticket links here so I can update the postmortem follow-up doc.
